name: Caffeine
summary: Caffeine is a stimulatory anti-sleep compound extracted from coffee beans. It is the most widely consumed psychoactive substance in the world.

evidenceMap.details: Reliably increases wakefulness and reduces the perception of fatigue, especially in sleep-deprived states.
Improves power output and endurance. Effective for both aerobic and anaerobic exercise.

dosage.instruction: To supplement for physical performance, take 3–6 mg/kg of body weight. For general wakefulness, 100–200 mg is standard.
dosage.timing: Take 30–60 minutes before the desired effect (e.g., workout or study session). Avoid within 6 hours of sleep.
dosage.notes: Tolerance builds up quickly. Cycling off for a few days can restore sensitivity.

citations.text: Grgic J, et al. Wakefulness-promoting effects of caffeine. Nutrients. (2020)

name: Creatine
summary: Creatine is a naturally occurring compound that helps supply energy to muscle cells.

evidenceMap.details: Significantly improves strength and power output in resistance training.

dosage.instruction: 5g per day, typically taken post-workout or with meals.
dosage.timing: Can be taken at any time, but post-workout may be optimal.
dosage.notes: Loading phase of 20g/day for 5-7 days is optional.

name: Omega-3
summary: Essential fatty acids that support brain health and reduce inflammation.

evidenceMap.details: Supports cognitive function and may reduce risk of cognitive decline.

dosage.notes: Fish oil supplements are a common source.
